business_milestone.title: Earn one dated commercial next step
business_milestone.definition: A real procurement task, an accountable owner and a dated scope or purchasing discussion. A polite reply does not qualify.
business_milestone.next: Reconcile the overdue Week 4 outreach record and hold the delayed Week 5 decision. Use substantive conversations to qualify a real need; Codex prepares a tailored scope within 24 hours of qualified evidence.

cloud_milestone.title: Move an operating desk off the laptop

gates.title: First scheduled check verified · idle, no model call
One desk migrated with equivalent inputs and receipts

cloud_milestone.next: One bounded customer-evidence memo is now delivered and reviewed in the cloud; this is not full desk migration. Preserve the older readiness review, verify the next scheduled occurrence and resolve equivalent inputs/receipts plus hosting continuity.

blockers.title: Buyer evidence is missing
blockers.impact: We cannot qualify a paid assignment or judge which product change buyers need.
blockers.next: Supply the actual outreach history and any existing notes; reconcile delivery, replies and conversations separately.

blockers.title: Distribution is ahead of measurement
blockers.impact: Published content has no attributable buyer response in the last readout. LinkedIn analytics and an X publication URL are missing.
blockers.next: Capture a dated LinkedIn analytics export or post metrics; verify the X destination before any publishing work.

blockers.title: Six desks still depend on desktop
blockers.impact: The metadata feed and bounded brief now run in the cloud. The six specialist desk workflows still need their own equivalent inputs and review controls.
blockers.next: Use the first cloud loop as the foundation, then migrate one specialist workflow and resolve hosting continuity beyond the trial.

asks.title: Close the outreach evidence gap
asks.why: This unlocks funnel diagnosis, useful follow-ups and the next commercial decision.
asks.request: Record who was actually contacted, when, the ask, delivery/reply status and any next step. Redacted notes are enough to start. No new replies were reported in your latest update; the original send history still needs reconciliation.
asks.next_owner: Listener reconciles the record; Supervisor recommends the next action.

asks.title: Review the customer evidence memo
asks.why: Task 38 has an independently reviewed cloud memo; task 39 is your Week 5 priority decision.
asks.request: Accept or return the exact task 38 memo, then choose the next access experiment in task 39. Provide actual send history first; zero recorded counters do not prove no activity.
asks.next_owner: Listener reconciles the supplied evidence; Oday owns sending.

asks.title: Accept or return the content readout
asks.why: Task #26 is a completed review packet waiting for your disposition.
asks.request: Review the exact content-to-buyer readout. Accept it or give a specific correction; this does not authorize another publication.
asks.next_owner: Editor carries the accepted learning into the next eligible piece.

workstreams.name: Shareable Trace
workstreams.now: Trace contract and sanitized sharing test accepted; fictional walkthrough available.
workstreams.next: Review the recipient prototype, then observe who a buyer would send it to.

workstreams.name: Product explainer
workstreams.now: “Your ERP records what happened. Trace-li makes it provable.” Copy reviewed.
workstreams.next: Choose the exact asset and destination when it is needed.

workstreams.name: Content & distribution
workstreams.now: First release is published; the content playbook is accepted. Buyer response is unproven.
workstreams.next: Resolve the readout review and collect meaningful feedback.

workstreams.name: Four account pieces
workstreams.now: UNFPA, OCHA, Chemonics and DAI packets have source and copy reviews.
workstreams.next: Refresh time-sensitive sources and prepare an exact external action packet.

workstreams.name: Product delivery
workstreams.now: Trace-first development sequence accepted; live secure sharing remains to be built.
workstreams.next: Use the sanitized Trace test to choose the smallest useful recipient workflow.

workstreams.name: Buyer discovery
workstreams.now: Task 38 decision memo produced on Railway and passed independent review. Week 4 counters remain zero recorded; actual denominators are unavailable.
workstreams.next: Oday reviews task 38, supplies task 28 send history and chooses the next access test in task 39.

workstreams.name: HQ & cloud operations
workstreams.now: One customer evidence memo ran in the cloud, persisted and passed independent review at zero model cost; replay returned the same artifact.
workstreams.next: Keep the earlier readiness draft at review. Observe the existing daily schedule; full desk parity and hosting continuity remain open.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.publication: The first company post and seven-page document have recorded publication URLs. The ArriveCAN LinkedIn handoff has no verified owner-published URL.
channels.feedback: No attributable substantive buyer response in the latest editorial readout. Impressions, saves and profile visits were unavailable.
channels.next: Add a dated analytics export and any substantive comments or messages, with a link to the post.

channels.name: X
channels.publication: The prepared thread has no verified live URL. A completed board task is not proof that the X post was published.
channels.feedback: No attributable engagement or buyer-response evidence is available.
channels.next: Confirm the company handle and any existing post URL before interpreting performance or preparing a release.

channels.name: Website
channels.publication: The first evidence-chain article and ArriveCAN article have verified release records and downloadable PDFs.
channels.feedback: Target-buyer visits and content-to-conversation attribution are not established.
channels.next: Track a concrete reply, introduction or named procurement task back to its source asset.

lessons.title: Require the send record before interpreting silence
lessons.observation: The cloud memo could verify saved zero counters but could not reconstruct actual outreach denominators or buyer language.
lessons.change: Proposal only: require send timestamp, delivery evidence and exact ask in the next owner handoff. No canonical memory change.
lessons.next_check: Oday reviews the proposal; then test whether the task 28 handoff supports a defensible task 29 denominator. Self-improvement gate remains unmet.

lessons.title: Verify deployment behavior, not just settings
lessons.observation: The first scheduled deployment failed during build even though the service schedule was saved.
lessons.change: Use an isolated worker bundle and check the actual deployment manifest and saved result.
lessons.next_check: First scheduled check verified 18 September: idle, no model call. Keep checking actual receipts on future runs.

lessons.title: Unchanged inputs should not buy another model call
lessons.observation: The restricted runner returned idle for the already-accepted source snapshot.
lessons.change: Deduplicate approved snapshots and keep cost reservations for uncertain calls.
lessons.next_check: A new draft requires a new approved snapshot and still stops for review.

lessons.title: Publication proves distribution, not demand
lessons.observation: Published assets exist, but the editorial readout has no attributable buyer response and no usable analytics.
lessons.change: Keep publication, engagement and commercial evidence separate. Do not infer product demand from silence.
lessons.next_check: Record a substantive reply or named task before changing the product thesis.

lessons.title: A review exception must stay specific
lessons.observation: The output Auditor hit its usage limit on the first cloud draft.
lessons.change: Oday approved an exception for that exact artifact. Future drafts retain their normal review requirements.
lessons.next_check: Check the reviewer and exact artifact before accepting the next output.
